entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Initial network attachment procedure where UE can request Reliable Data Service.

entities.name: UE-requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests establishment of a PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element used to carry Reliable Data Service request and acceptance.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to activate default bearer, containing Reliable Data Service acceptance.

entities.name: Control plane only indicator set
entities.description: Condition where PDN connection has control plane only indicator set.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization without user plane move
entities.description: Condition where PDN connection uses control plane CIoT EPS optimization and MME does not move to user plane.

entities.name: Reliable Data Service accepted
entities.description: Property indicating network has accepted UE's request for Reliable Data Service usage.

entities.name: PDN connection exclusive for Reliable Data Service
entities.description: Property that UE shall use PDN connection exclusively for Reliable Data Service if accepted.

relations.description: UE can request Reliable Data Service in extended PCO IE during attach procedure.
UE can request Reliable Data Service in extended PCO IE during PDN connectivity procedure.
Reliable Data Service may only be used when control plane only indicator is set.
Reliable Data Service may only be used with control plane CIoT EPS optimization without user plane move.
Network informs UE about Reliable Data Service acceptance in extended PCO IE in this message.
If Reliable Data Service is accepted, UE shall use PDN connection exclusively for RDS.
